item.description:
The No-Regrets Guide to Setting Up Cloudflare: Stories, Checkpoints, and Real-World Success
Switching your domain to Cloudflare is often described as simple. But as anyone who’s shepherded a real site through DNS changes knows, the “three-click” promise rarely matches reality. I still remember the time I inherited a client site and, within minutes of following a quick-start guide, managed to cut off their email for two days, just because one obscure DNS record slipped through the cracks.
